maya: Heads-up: I'm opening a PR to change how the Python SDK attaches routing policies and quota tags. This is part of v2 cleanup — it moves routing policy into an explicit RequestPolicy object instead of implicit headers. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-python/pull/432 :eyes:

alex: Can you show the current -> new usage? quick snippet helps.

maya: sure — current is very implicit, e.g.:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('write a haiku')  # server auto-injects x-redwood-routing from config
```
New explicit pattern:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RequestPolicy
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
policy = RequestPolicy(region='us-west', priority='low', quota_tags={'team':'search'})
resp = client.generate('write a haiku', policy=policy)
```

linh: Two quick questions: 1) telemetry/console — will dashboards that group by routing header break? 2) can we still set a default at client instantiation?

maya: good Qs. TL;DR: dashboards won't break if we emit a compatibility metric and keep the header for one release. Plan: v2 emits `x-redwood-routing` for legacy compatibility when `enable_legacy_headers=True` (default for one release) and also emits `sdk.routing_policy_source` telemetry tag with values `implicit|explicit|legacy-emitted`. Client can still accept a default RequestPolicy at init: `RedwoodClient(default_policy=...)`.

priya: We have a Dedicated customer (FinCorp) who reads headers in their gateway for quota accounting. Need a pinned deprecation timeline and a config knob. Also we should add a WARN log when legacy header is relied on.

diego: Proposal: ship v2 as opt-in initially (beta on pypi as `redwood-sdk==2.0b1`) with `enable_legacy_headers=True` default. After 30d of telemetry showing adoption, flip default to False for next release and add server-side notice if header missing. Meanwhile add migration guide and a helper: `client.set_default_policy_from_env()` for infra.

alex: Sounds fine. Two follow-ups: A) add a compatibility CI test that verifies header emission when `enable_legacy_headers` is on/off. B) ensure TS/Go SDKs follow same pattern to keep routing policy parity.

maya: yes to both. I've added CI job `sdk-compat-routing` in the PR that runs a tiny request matrix. deploy-bot: job failed once due to linting but green now.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: `sdk-compat-routing` passed on branch `feature/sdk-routing-refactor` — 1 run, 1/1 passed.

linh: For the console: we'll add a migration flag to dashboards that maps `sdk.routing_policy_source=legacy-emitted` to the existing routing field for 2 weeks after the flip. We'll also tag any alerting rules that use routing headers with a notice.

priya: Can we add a short deprecation notice in the header response if server gets a request with the old implicit header missing? Something like `Warning: routing header deprecated, see docs` — customers may need to detect it.

maya: server can add a `Warning` response header but need eng-platform approval; tagging @eng-platform in the PR description. For now we'll rely on SDK emitting `x-redwood-routing` until we flip default.

diego: One more ops note — autoscaling routing (smart routing) uses `priority` field; make sure RequestPolicy has `priority` enumerated and we validate at client-side to avoid noisy server logs.

alex: +1. Also add a deprecation logger event that will appear in the console with counts per customer so account managers can see who still uses legacy flow.

maya: Will do. Plan summary in PR body: short deprecation timeline, beta release, env knobs, CI, telemetry tags, console mapping for 2 weeks, and migration helper. Asking for reviews from eng-platform/telemetry/docs.

priya: Approve in principle. Add FinCorp to early beta list and ping them.

diego: I'll add the feature flag and CI job. Happy to own roll-forward if metrics show regressions.

alex: Minor: update CHANGELOG with code examples and add a snippet for `pip install redwood-sdk==2.0b1` and a migration checklist.

maya: Thanks. I'll update PR. Will schedule a short sync if anyone wants to walk through the migration. :wave:

linh: If you can drop the console mapping PR link here after you create it, I can link dashboards.

maya: will do — thanks all! :thumbsup:
